headlines.snippet: Irajchi received the American response to the seven-point plan proposal. This marks a significant development in diplomatic efforts.

headlines.snippet: The Saudi regime is seeking an impossible victory in Yemen. The ongoing war has severe implications for the region.

headlines.snippet: Hamas called for the launch of the 'Great Dawn' campaign in support of Jerusalem. The call aims to mobilize support for the city.

headlines.title: Vessel struck by unknown projectile in Strait of Hormuz, UKMTO says
headlines.snippet: A vessel was struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, causing a fire. The UK Maritime Trade Operations reported the incident, and the crew is safe.

headlines.title: Syria, EU discuss new agreement, recovery and Israeli withdrawal
headlines.snippet: Syria and the EU discussed a new agreement, recovery efforts, and Israeli withdrawal. Damascus urged the EU to demand Israeli forces leave the occupied territories.

headlines.title: Saudi Arabia reaffirms support for Sudan’s stability, sovereignty
headlines.snippet: Saudi Arabia reaffirmed its support for Sudan's stability and sovereignty. Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman conveyed this commitment during a call with Abdel Fattah al-Burhan.

headlines.title: Syrian FM, EU foreign policy chief discuss ties, economic recovery and reconstruction
headlines.snippet: Syrian Foreign Minister Asaad Hassan al-Shaibani met with EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas to discuss bilateral relations and cooperation. They covered regional developments and reconstruction efforts.

headlines.title: Syria allows non-exclusive agencies for foreign vehicle and tire firms
headlines.snippet: Syria will permit foreign vehicle, machinery, and tire companies to establish non-exclusive agencies and open branches. This move aims to encourage foreign investment.

headlines.title: Syria is rising, al-Sharaa tells UN—but challenges remain at home
headlines.snippet: Syria is experiencing diplomatic rehabilitation, but challenges remain at home. Al-Sharaa faces the task of translating international acceptance into economic progress and restored sovereignty.

headlines.snippet: Hero FlyDubai pilot Smit Machchhar moved to Abu Dhabi hospital Arab News

headlines.title: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi lauds FlyDubai “hero” pilot Smit Machchhar
headlines.snippet: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi lauded the FlyDubai pilot Smit Machchhar as a 'hero'. The pilot's actions were credited with averting disaster.

headlines.title: Indian FlyDubai pilot Smit Machchhar praised for bravery during cockpit attack
headlines.snippet: Indian FlyDubai pilot Smit Machchhar praised for bravery during cockpit attack Arab News

headlines.title: Gas pipeline blast near Damascus forces 3 Syrian power plants offline
headlines.snippet: A gas pipeline blast near Damascus forced three Syrian power plants offline. The explosion caused significant disruption to the energy supply.

headlines.title: FlyDubai pilot tried to crash Israel-bound passenger jet after stabbing colleague, Netanyahu says
headlines.snippet: The Flydubai pilot attempted to crash the Israel-bound passenger jet after stabbing a colleague, according to Netanyahu. The incident occurred in the cockpit.

headlines.title: UAE orders investigation into flydubai Tel Aviv flight incident
headlines.snippet: The UAE has ordered an investigation into the Flydubai Tel Aviv flight incident. Authorities are examining the circumstances that led to the diversion.

headlines.title: US exits Iraq as Trump cites victory over Daesh, vows Iran war ending ‘very soon’
headlines.snippet: US exits Iraq, with Trump citing victory over Daesh and vowing to end the Iran war 'very soon.' This marks a significant shift in US military presence.

headlines.title: Houthi drone hits Medina power station supplying Prophet’s Mosque
headlines.snippet: A Houthi drone hit a power station in Medina that supplies the Prophet's Mosque. The attack has been widely condemned.

headlines.title: Hero flydubai pilot Capt. Smit Machchhar airlifted to UAE; Indian Ambassador visits him
headlines.snippet: Heroic Flydubai pilot Capt. Smit Machchhar was airlifted to the UAE, and the Indian Ambassador visited him. He was recognized for his actions during the emergency.

headlines.title: Emirates Dubai-London A380 diverts to Frankfurt after passenger medical emergency
headlines.snippet: An Emirates Dubai-London A380 flight diverted to Frankfurt due to a passenger medical emergency. The flight rerouted to ensure the passenger received necessary medical attention.

headlines.title: OIC, Arab states condemn drone attack on Saudi Arabia's Medina power station
headlines.snippet: The OIC and Arab states condemned the drone attack on Saudi Arabia's Medina power station. Several countries voiced solidarity with Saudi Arabia.

headlines.title: Tanker struck by unknown projectile in Strait of Hormuz catches fire: UK maritime agency
headlines.snippet: A tanker in the Strait of Hormuz was struck by an unknown projectile, causing a fire. The crew is safe, and an investigation is underway.

headlines.title: Initial probe finds Flydubai co-pilot ‘assaulted’ captain before emergency landing in Saudi Arabia
headlines.snippet: An initial probe found the Flydubai co-pilot 'assaulted' the captain before the emergency landing in Saudi Arabia. Both pilots sustained injuries.

headlines.title: Trump vows to attack Iran 'very hard' if Tehran behind Flydubai flight incident
headlines.snippet: US President Trump vowed to attack Iran 'very hard' if Tehran is found to be behind the Flydubai flight incident. He issued a stern warning to Iran.

headlines.title: Palestinian killed, 3 injured in Israeli strike on displaced people’s tent in Gaza despite truce
headlines.snippet: A Palestinian was killed and three injured in an Israeli strike on a displaced people's tent in Gaza. The strike occurred despite a reported truce.

headlines.title: US tells European allies to release diesel stocks 'immediately'
headlines.snippet: The United States urged its European allies to release diesel stocks immediately to help lower global prices. EU member states were set to discuss the matter.

headlines.title: Who is the storyteller in the age of AI?
headlines.snippet: The role of the storyteller in the age of AI is explored. The piece contrasts ancient storytelling traditions with modern digital narratives.

headlines.title: When news disappears, who controls digital memory?
headlines.snippet: The disappearance of news and control over digital memory is discussed. A boatman's testimony before Bangladesh's International Crimes Tribunal is highlighted.

headlines.title: Türkiye condemns Houthis' attack on holy city of Medina
headlines.snippet: Türkiye condemned the Houthi drone attack on the holy city of Medina. The country reaffirmed its support for Saudi Arabia following the incident.

headlines.title: Suspect in flydubai attack handed over to UAE, Saudi authorities say
headlines.snippet: The suspect in the Flydubai attack has been handed over to the UAE, according to Saudi authorities. The co-pilot allegedly stabbed the captain on the flight.

headlines.title: PHOTO Best restaurants in Istanbul, ranked
headlines.snippet: A PHOTO feature presents the best restaurants in Istanbul, ranked by a jury of experts for the 'Pearly Gastronomy Guide'.

headlines.title: Journalist Muhammad al-Najjar killed in Gaza as Israeli strikes kill eight Palestinians
headlines.snippet: Journalist Muhammad al-Najjar was killed in Gaza during Israeli strikes that claimed the lives of eight Palestinians. The incident occurred amid ongoing conflict.

headlines.title: Eritrea breaks diplomatic ties with Ethiopia
headlines.snippet: Eritrea has officially broken diplomatic ties with Ethiopia. The reasons for this decision have been stated by Eritrean authorities.

headlines.title: Pro-Iran factions refuse to disarm as Iraqi government sets new deadline
headlines.snippet: Pro-Iran factions in Iraq have refused to disarm, despite the Iraqi government setting a new deadline. This refusal poses a challenge to security consolidation.

headlines.title: Trump warns war against Iran will end 'very soon, one way or another'
headlines.snippet: Trump warned that the war against Iran will end 'very soon, one way or another.' He made this statement regarding the ongoing tensions.

headlines.title: Saudi Arabia investigates flydubai emergency landing in Tabuk
headlines.snippet: Saudi Arabia is investigating the Flydubai emergency landing in Tabuk. The incident involved a flight diversion to Saudi territory for an emergency landing.
